authoring_skill: williamriveromd-hero-vignette v3 · Scaffold A (people) · Composition archetype A — Editorial Portrait
alt: A Filipino man in his fifties at a bright clinic desk holds up a vitamin bottle beside a phone photo of its label while reviewing his medicine list
tell_back: He brought his vitamin bottle so the doctor can check it.

alt: Share card reading "Vitamin B1 and Niacin in Kidney Care" with a bowl of rice and two vitamin capsules
tell_back: A guide about two vitamins and kidney care.

alt: Two side-by-side panels: on the left a glowing cell powerhouse fed by vitamin B1 turning food into energy; on the right three labeled bottles showing food niacin, nicotinic acid medicine, and nicotinamide
tell_back: B1 is about running low; B3 is about which kind and how much.

authoring_skill: williamriveromd-infographic-skill v5 · Archetype 8 (radial) with photoreal vignettes
alt: Radial infographic with a vitamin B1 tank in the center draining toward six surrounding photos of situations that lower vitamin B1: dialysis, days of vomiting, weight-loss surgery, weight-loss injections, heavy alcohol use, and interrupted tube or vein feeding
tell_back: If any of these is you, ask your care team about vitamin B1.

alt: Patient poster with three groups of warning signs of low vitamin B1: belly signs, brain and nerve signs, and heart signs, with an urgent triangle beside the brain and heart signs
tell_back: Belly signs: call your team. Brain or heart signs: go to the ER now.

alt: Three labeled containers comparing food niacin, high-dose nicotinic acid medicine, and nicotinamide, each with a short line about what it does and its main caution
tell_back: Same name, three different things; only the medicine form changes cholesterol.

alt: Four-step path for statin side effects: check other causes, adjust the statin, add or switch to proven medicines such as ezetimibe, bempedoic acid or a PCSK9 injection, and keep LDL down; a small crossed-out niacin bottle sits off the path
tell_back: If statins bother you, your doctor has other proven options; niacin is not one of them.

authoring_skill: williamriveromd-infographic-skill v5 · photoreal flat-lay with numbered labels
alt: Flat-lay of items a patient brings to a clinic visit: a supplement bottle, a phone photo of a label, a handwritten list of statins tried with dates, and a dialysis schedule card
tell_back: Bring these five things to your next visit.

audience: Clinicians (patients can read the top row)
alt: Mechanism figure of a cell: glucose to pyruvate in the cytoplasm, a thiamine diphosphate-dependent gate at pyruvate dehydrogenase into the mitochondrion, the Krebs cycle and ATP output; when the gate closes, pyruvate is diverted to lactate
tell_back: Without B1 the cell's power plant locks, and lactate spills over.

alt: Minimal line-art sigil: a small gold droplet representing the body's thiamine pool at the center, with the gut feeding it, the kidneys and dialysis draining it, and the brain and heart drawing on it, connected by dotted curved arrows
tell_back: The kidneys and gut fill and drain one small B1 pool that the brain and heart depend on.

alt: Portrait clinical algorithm: risk and compatible symptoms lead to red-flag screening; red flags route to emergency care and parenteral thiamine; otherwise draw whole-blood thiamine diphosphate and lactate, start thiamine without waiting, evaluate other causes in parallel, and reassess symptoms, lactate and neurologic status
tell_back: Check for danger signs, draw blood, give B1 now, and keep looking for other causes.

alt: Timeline infographic across five days of refeeding: thiamine before the first feed, staged nutrition advance, daily phosphate, potassium and magnesium checks, with markers showing whether each blood sample was drawn before or after a dialysis session
tell_back: After dialysis, phosphate and potassium drop anyway; compare like with like.

alt: Clinician infographic with two columns: on the left HDL cholesterol rising and triglycerides falling on niacin; on the right event bars for niacin and placebo that are nearly equal in two large trials, with a harms strip below
tell_back: The lab numbers improved; heart attacks and strokes did not.

alt: Clinician reference card mapping LDL-lowering eligibility in CKD by age, eGFR, chronic dialysis, kidney transplant and established ASCVD, comparing KDIGO and 2026 ACC/AHA framing
tell_back: Most people with kidney disease who are not on dialysis should be on cholesterol-lowering medicine.

authoring_skill: williamriveromd-simple-figure · Scaffold D variant (single data chart)
alt: Chart of the NOPHOS trial: the difference in serum phosphate between nicotinamide and placebo was −0.39 mg/dL at week 24 with a confidence interval below zero, and −0.08 mg/dL at week 52 with an interval crossing zero, beside a list of safety signals
tell_back: The phosphate effect faded within a year.
